policy.pairwise_converter_policy: Add only routes that serve a real workflow or independent cross-validation.
policy.runnable_cases: Each runnable conversion Case owns its input mesh and runtime configuration. Route coverage is recorded separately from Case identity.

routes.input_scope: One connected, closed, axis-aligned planar quadrilateral boundary in ASCII or binary STL; explicit four-edge boundary sidecar; structured QUAD_4 layouts.
routes.output_scope: Gmsh MSH 4.1 ASCII with LINE_2 Physical Curves and a QUAD_4 Physical Surface.
routes.evidence: grid/stl/test_stl_to_gmsh.py checks geometry construction, MSH 4.1 inspection, one-cell and two-cell topology, and Physical Group names.

routes.input_scope: MSH 4.1 ASCII; first-order LINE_2, TRI_3, QUAD_4, TETRA_4, HEXA_8, PENTA_6, PYRA_5
routes.evidence: GmshCgnsConversionTest independently reopens CGNS and checks mesh and boundary data.

artifacts: Configured native OneFLOW grid target, or Case results/<source-stem>.oneflow.grid by default
routes.evidence: GmshCgnsConversionTest verifies the retained CGNS Base/Zone/BC_t data, the separate native OneFLOW grid output, OneFLOW UnsGrid node/cell/face counts and coordinates, and per-boundary OneFLOW BC type/name identity attached to the expected geometric edge.

not_implemented.reason: No current workflow or validated semantic mapping requires this route.
